statement:
let f := fun k : ℕ => 4*k^2+1; let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc (x/2) x; let primes := fun z : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 3 z).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p); let wheel := fun z : ℕ => ∏ p ∈ primes z, p; let rough := fun x z : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun k => Nat.Coprime (f k) (wheel z)); ∀ x z : ℕ, 2≤x → z≤2*x → (2*x)^2+1≤z^3 →
  (∑ k ∈ (block x).filter (fun k => (f k).Prime), Real.log (f k : ℝ)) =
    ∑ k ∈ rough x z, (1 - (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (f k) : ℝ))/2 * Real.log (f k : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0084 · 在终带用 Möbius 的符号精确计入真素数值
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0084 · Use the Möbius sign to count the actual prime values in the terminal range

brief.zh: 终带存活值至多两个素因子，平方情形由 QP-0064 排除。素数值在此窗均大于 2x。半素数的 μ 为 +1，素数的 μ 为 −1。
brief.en: A terminal survivor has at most two prime factors. QP-0064 excludes the square, and every prime value in this window exceeds 2x. A semiprime contributes μ=+1 and a prime μ=−1.
